name: 7 satellites
location_str: LC-9A @ Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: Share ride of 7 satellites to sun-synchronous orbit, including the ham radio satellite BY70-4. Details TBD.
slot_b_text: A sun-synchronous orbit is tilted so the satellite crosses the equator at the same local time on every pass. Shadows fall the same way in every image, which is why almost all Earth-observation satellites use it.

rocket_fact: Liquid Hydrogen fuel is so cold (-423°F) that it would instantly freeze air into a solid block of nitrogen ice.
